purpose: A change of tone and length for the cover letter, asked after it is written.
correct_behaviour: The cover letter is redrafted warmer and more personal and under 250 words, with the same true facts.

requests.text: Please make the cover letter warmer and more personal, and keep it under 250 words.
requests.correct_behaviour: The final cover letter is noticeably warmer and personal, has under 250 words, and adds no claim the candidate's material lacks.
